confidence.comment: Computed over the generated action tokens. Thresholds are tuned on the calibration slice of train (use-case-evals-poc/runs/tune_router.py), never on held-out.
confidence.tuned_on: train[400:500] with ft-e4b-r1: logprobs did not separate failures from successes (best utility = validators only). Kept as a loose gate on tool-call steps only (-6 min / -0.35 mean); validators + reply grounding carry the routing. Re-tune on held-back traffic before relying on it.

policy.comment: file_claim with amount over the threshold always goes to the teacher (or a human).

never_leave.comment: Requests that mention diagnoses or medications never leave the phone. They are answered locally or handed to a human with escalate_to_human (topic=medical), which is the insurer's own system, not a cloud model. Keyword rules are brittle: paraphrases like 'doctor say I have anxiety' slipped past the first version (found in eval, 2026-11-08). Production should add a small on-device classifier.
never_leave.regex: \b(diagnos\w*|medication\w*|prescri\w*|insulin|chemo\w*|cancer|tumou?r|hiv|depress\w*|anxiety|panic attacks?|adhd|bipolar|schizo\w*|pregnan\w*|miscarriage|diabet\w*|asthma|arthritis|herniat\w*|torn (?:acl|meniscus|ligament)|fractur\w*|injur(?:y|ies|ed)|antidepressant\w*|opioid\w*|adderall|ozempic|metformin|lexapro|zoloft|xanax|symptom\w*|biopsy|high blood pressure|blood pressure|(?:doctor|dr\.?) (?:say|says|said|told me) (?:i|that i) (?:have|had|might have))\b

ood.comment: Async, in the cloud, on synced redacted traces: cosine distance to the nearest training request (embeddinggemma-300m).
